requirement.description: The runner fails to properly handle missing parameters in function calls, causing RuntimeError when parameters are not provided. Multiple test cases show "Parameter X was not given a value" errors.
requirement.contract: Function parameters that are not provided in the template inputs should either use their default values or be skipped entirely when calling the function. The function call should not fail when optional parameters are missing.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_serialisers.py::test_parameter_loading[pydantic-input-with-loader-on-attribute-1], tests/test_serialisers.py::test_parameter_loading[pydantic-input-with-loader-on-attribute-2], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_inputs_params[test parameter only input variations-1], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_inputs_params[test parameter only input variations-2]

requirement.description: The runner incorrectly handles directory creation when saving outputs, resulting in IsADirectoryError. Tests fail when trying to write to paths that are directories instead of files.
requirement.contract: When saving outputs, the system should ensure that output paths are not directories. If a path resolves to a directory, it should create an output file within that directory instead of trying to write to the directory itself.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_with_result[pydantic output with result output-1], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_with_result[pydantic output with result output-2], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_artifacts[pydantic io artifact output variations-1], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_artifacts[pydantic io artifact output variations-2], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_params[pydantic output parameter variations-1], tests/test_runner.py::test_runner_pydantic_output_params[pydantic output parameter variations-2]

requirement.description: The parameter loading mechanism fails to properly handle Pydantic validation errors for missing fields. Tests show "field required" and "missing argument" errors when loading parameters that should be valid.
requirement.contract: When loading parameters with Pydantic models, the system should properly handle validation errors and provide meaningful error messages. Missing fields should be handled gracefully or validated properly according to the model definition.

requirement.description: Artifact loading fails with type checking errors for non-base Pydantic models. Tests fail with "instance of X expected" errors indicating incorrect type checking.
requirement.contract: When loading artifacts, the system should correctly handle non-Pydantic base models and ensure proper type checking. Artifacts with custom loaders should be processed correctly regardless of their inheritance hierarchy.

requirement.description: The function parameter mapping logic does not properly handle kebab-case to snake_case conversion for parameter names, leading to missing parameter values in function calls.
requirement.contract: Parameter names in the template inputs should be properly converted from kebab-case to snake_case (and vice versa) to match function parameter names. This ensures that parameters with hyphens in their names are correctly mapped to Python function parameters.
